original_test_intent: Inventory active BMC sessions through the intended path and assess their state/policy without terminating or altering them.
original_method: Do not guess a session command; require the vendor read API, field schema, bounded pagination, authorization, redaction, freshness and non-mutation proof.
manual_activity: Security owner and vendor define the authorized inventory fields and policy; operator confirms bounded scope and sensitive-data handling.
agent_execution_scope: After approval perform one bounded read

command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until a proven read-only vendor inventory method is approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Retrieve a bounded authorized inventory, validate identifiers/state/channel/privilege/time and pagination, redact sensitive fields and prove no session changed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the absent inventory contract without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong command may terminate sessions or disclose security metadata.

project_override_considerations: An OOB/API override must preserve the intended path and identical inventory semantics; a close-session API is never an acceptable substitute.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title implies security-sensitive enumeration while Procedure/Criteria are TBD, and log clearing contradicts required audit preservation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read versus terminate semantics, record scope and sensitive fields are core; guessing could disrupt operators or expose credentials.

review_improvement: Separates read-only session inventory from session-control operations and defines bounded redacted evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Even an inventory read can expose identities and privilege/source metadata. With no API, fields or authorization, automation cannot safely distinguish enumeration from session control, so the case remains blocked under security ownership.
